items.headline: Man United defeats Ipswich Town 5-2 in emphatic response to Hull loss
items.summary: Manchester United bounced back from opening weekend defeat with commanding 5-2 victory over Ipswich Town on Saturday.

items.headline: Manchester United closes transfer window with 7 signings and 24 departures
items.summary: Summer 2026 transfer window ends with midfielder focus: Andrey Santos, Youri Tielemans and Carlos Baleba join; no new left-back or striker added.

items.headline: Dan Gore secures Luton Town loan for 2026/27 season
items.summary: Manchester United academy prospect Dan Gore joins Luton Town on loan for the upcoming season.

items.headline: Jayce Fitzgerald joins Rotherham United on loan
items.summary: Young player Jayce Fitzgerald moves to Rotherham United on loan from Manchester United.

items.headline: Louis Jackson completes permanent transfer to St Mirren
items.summary: Manchester United confirm forward Louis Jackson has joined Scottish club St Mirren on permanent deal.

items.headline: Bruno Fernandes hat-trick earns place in history
items.summary: Bruno Fernandes' three-goal performance against Ipswich marks a significant historical milestone for Manchester United.
